rounding_note: GHF equation (25) uses 0.13, whereas dividing the rounded prefactors of (23) and (24) gives 1.4/11=0.12727... . The code preserves each printed expression and does not enforce exact equality between rounded formulas.
table_blanks: Blank Table 1 entries remain null and are omitted, not interpreted as measured zero coefficients.
